text:
Situation: Rocuronium bromide has been on the FDA drug shortage list since 2023-02-15 and remains listed as Current as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 44 months. The list includes Baxter Healthcare, Eugia US LLC, Fresenius Kabi USA LLC, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., Hospira Inc., Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc., Mylan Institutional, Piramal Critical Care Inc., Sagent Pharmaceuticals, Sandoz Inc., and XGen Pharmaceuticals DJB Inc., all with Current status. Corvale East holds 42 SDV (11.1 days), 15 MDV 5 mL (3.5 days), and 42 MDV 10 mL (10.7 days). Corvale General holds three lots totaling 206.3 units (13.6–22.6 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 27 units (28.5 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1254066 at Hikma Farmaceutica (Portugal) S.A. ended 2023-02-03 and was classified VAI, 12 days before the shortage posting. FDA inspection 1203129 at the same plant ended 2023-04-21 and was classified VAI, 65 days after the posting. The Hospira Inc. plant (FEI 1021343) received OAI classifications after inspections ending 2010-01-19 and 2011-06-17, with a warning letter issued 2010-04-12. A second Hospira inspection ending 2011-08-04 was also OAI. A warning letter was issued to Hikma Farmaceutica (Portugal) S.A. on 2014-10-21.

Our position: Corvale East is critically low on the 5 mL MDV presentation (3.5 days). Corvale General and Corvale Lakeside have sufficient supply to support transfers. An alternate manufacturer (HF Acquisition Co LLC, DBA HealthFirst) is approved for substitution. Two additional suppliers (B. Braun Medical Inc., BE Pharmaceuticals Inc.) are not on the FDA shortage list but their manufacturing sites are not identifiable from labels.

Recommended actions:
1. Execute transfer of 13 units from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director transfer request.
2. Execute transfer of 39 units from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director transfer request.
3. Activate alternate manufacturer HF Acquisition Co LLC (HealthFirst) for ROCURONIUM BROMIDE 10 mg/mL — requires pharmacist verification.
4. Evaluate purchase from B. Braun Medical Inc. — requires buyer assessment of supply reliability and site transparency.
5. Evaluate purchase from BE Pharmaceuticals Inc. — requires buyer assessment of supply reliability and site transparency.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing or protocol changes; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
